# Example

Проверь изменения и верни результат.

candidates.title: Description cannot route concrete requests to the skill

evidence.execution_path: Skill discovery sees only the name and description before deciding whether to load the body
evidence.violated_invariant: The description must identify both the capability and concrete trigger contexts
evidence.falsifier_checked: The complete frontmatter contains no additional trigger terms or request examples

candidates.impact: Relevant frontend requests may not activate the skill, while unrelated requests may activate it accidentally.
candidates.recommendation: Name the review capability and the concrete frontend PR, TypeScript, UI, async, and accessibility request triggers in description.

verdicts.reason: The frontmatter shown to discovery contains capability prose but no actionable trigger context.
